tables.text: Table 398, "RNG configurations", in section 47.6.2 (Validation conditions) on page 2296. Columns: Configuration, RNG_CR bits, RNG_CR bits, RNG_CR bits, RNG_CR bits, RNG_CR bits, Loop number (N), RNG_ HTCR register, RNG_ NSCR register. 5 data row(s). Notes: 1. 0x1 value is recommended instead of 0x0 for RNG_CONFIG2[2:0], when RNG power consumption is critical. See the end of Section47.3.8 for details.; 2. RNG_CONFIG3[1:0] defines the loop number N: 0x0 c.

notes: 1. 0x1 value is recommended instead of 0x0 for RNG_CONFIG2[2:0], when RNG power consumption is critical. See the end of Section47.3.8 for details.
2. RNG_CONFIG3[1:0] defines the loop number N: 0x0 corresponds to N=1, 0x1 to N=2, 0x2 to N=3, 0x3 to N=4

3. The noise source sampling must be 32MHz or less. Hence, if the RNG clock is different from 64MHz, this value of CLKDIV must be adapted. See the CLKDIV bitfield description in Section47.7.1 for details.
4. This value can be fixed in the RNG driver (it does not depend upon the STM32 product).
